dct_description_sm: Annually, Agnico-Eagle Mines (AEM) submits to the NIRB a Wildlife Monitoring Summary Reports for the project to meet the terms and conditions as stipulated in the NIRB project Certificate. The purpose of this report is to summarize data collected annually from the various wildlife monitoring programs including breeding plot surveys, bird transect surveys, waterfowl surveys, raptor surveys, hunter harvest studies, environmental health surveys and caribou collaring data interpretation in collaboration with the GN Department of Environment. These data will continue to be collected through the operation and post operation of the mine to identify and communicate natural variation and potential mine-related changes in wildlife populations and environmental health within and adjacent to the Meadowbank project area through the interpretation of accumulative monitoring datasets.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environmental health
dct_title_s: Wildlife Monitoring in the Meadowbank Mine site, Kivalliq Region, Nunavut
